deferred.name: printableItems

deferred.name: paginateItems

deferred.name: documentPagesHtml
deferred.reason: Delegates to document-specific documentPageHtml and owns layout composition.

deferred.name: waitForPdfStageAssets
deferred.reason: Uses document.fonts, image decode and requestAnimationFrame; requires browser/visual regression.

deferred.name: branchCompany
deferred.reason: Reads window.CurrentUser and merges controller-local branch defaults.

deferred.name: addItem
deferred.reason: Mutates controller state and triggers render lifecycle.

deferred.reason: Mutates controller state and triggers render lifecycle.

guard: Do not extract printableItems/paginateItems solely because bodies match. Add page-partition regression tests first, including empty rows, long wrapped rows and multi-page boundaries.
